source_title: Joshimath Chopper Crash: Search On For Missing Trans Bharat Flight - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
A helicopter carrying six individuals, including five passengers and a pilot, went missing and crashed near Joshimath in Uttarakhand's Chamoli district. The aircraft, operated by Trans Bharat Aviation, departed from Badrinath at 1:14 p.m. bound for Sahastradhara heliport in Dehradun before communication was lost while traversing the Joshimath valley. Following the incident, the Chamoli district administration, the State Disaster Response Force, and an Indian Army unit were deployed to the suspected crash site to conduct search and rescue operations. As a precautionary measure, the entire fleet of Trans Bharat Aviation helicopters has been grounded. Adverse weather conditions in the mountainous terrain have created severe hurdles for emergency rescue personnel attempting to access the site. An investigation into the exact cause of the crash will follow the ongoing search and rescue efforts.
